properties.name: optimize.notification.hub.base-url
properties.description: Base URL of the Notification Hub API (no trailing slash).

properties.name: optimize.notification.hub.tenant-id
properties.description: Optional X-Tenant-Id header (local/dev when JWT tenant claim is absent).

properties.name: optimize.notification.hub.environment
properties.description: Client delivery environment for SMS (test|prod). When unset, derived from the active Spring profile (prod/production → prod, otherwise test).

properties.name: optimize.notification.hub.oauth2.enabled
properties.description: Fetch and attach Bearer tokens via client credentials.

properties.name: optimize.notification.hub.oauth2.client-secret
properties.description: Service account client secret (prefer env/secret store).

properties.name: optimize.notification.hub.oauth2.refresh-skew-seconds
properties.description: Refresh cached token this many seconds before expiry.

values.description: Email the SMS to sms@optimizesolux.com (no paid SMS).
Send a real SMS via the configured provider.
